evidence.notes: Takes a direct object in both listed senses: allumer une flamme (light a flame) and allumer la lumière/un appareil (switch on).
Transitive améliorer quelque chose (to improve something), as the usage note contrasts with pronominal s'améliorer.
Direct-object construction in all listed senses: arracher quelque chose (pull out, tear off/out).
assister à un événement is intransitive (to attend), while direct-object assister quelqu'un is transitive (to assist someone), as the usage note states.

Direct-object uses (assurer quelque chose = ensure/insure/maintain) predominate; intransitive use is also current (assurer = to be reliable or do well). Uncertainty: the listed glosses are all transitive, so intransitive is included on general usage rather than source evidence.
